head: 410ea2551fe70e6a2b9ba229ec4c9f879d92afc7
scope: Native Finance payables: standalone supplier bills, Commerce fulfillment matched bills, Procurement match lifecycle, retained source version, posted goods-journal guard, matched draft/posted void, receipt-version validation, stranded-match repair, and a scoped foreign-currency goods-FX gate.

implemented.procurement_match: packages/server-procurement/src/adapters/finance_supplier_bill_match.rs: lock/load the reviewed match, stage posted with an event, and return on void with receipt deactivation. Finance validates match status/version/invoice link, supplier, dates, accounts, totals, primary fulfillment and every active receipt version.
implemented.variance_lines: Matched bills debit clearing at expected subtotal, post the price variance to the approved variance account, debit input tax and credit payable at the actual total.
implemented.source_version: migrations/postgres/holding-write/1100_finance_invoice_source_version.sql retains the post-link Commerce version; Finance compares it at post time.
implemented.repair: migrations/postgres/holding-write/1101_procurement_bill_match_repair.sql repairs pre-port matches stranded by earlier native posts/voids, with events and receipt deactivation.
implemented.matched_void: Finance allows commerce_fulfillment in draft/posted void; the composition releases the Commerce fulfillment link and returns the Procurement match (status returned, invoice_id null, version+1, event). Posted void keeps the exact reversal, independent approver, period/allocation guards and receipt.
implemented.fx_gate: Native Finance rejects a foreign-currency commerce invoice with SUPPLIER_BILL_GOODS_FX_UNSUPPORTED before writes; the native client falls back only for that scoped code to the retained Commerce goods-carrying FX posting path.
implemented.ui: packages/feature-finance/src/components/invoice-controls.tsx exposes draft/posted void for commerce_fulfillment payables as well as standalone.
implemented.http: Private HTTP 4xx responses preserve application/json; the app route surfaces the native business code.

gates.finance.rust-supplier-bill-postgres.inte: 14/14 pass in 69.34 s (matched post, variance, receipt versions, draft/posted void, replay, re-match, bad period, non-purchase, stale/unposted source)
gates.sales.commerce-foreign-goods.integration: 5/5 pass; Commerce retains the finance_invoice draft:v1 snapshot
gates.finance.generic-payments.integration: 17/17 pass (heavy inbox case timeout raised to 60 s; assertions unchanged)
gates.finance unit suites: 149/149 pass (8 files; InvoiceActions harness supports React.Fragment)
gates.migration: 1100 and 1101 applied to H001/H002/H003; no stranded invoiced/posted matches remain

runtime.matched_post: invoice-401700d00713b1b95d5eddee11eb8bcc6408 posted through the app route with journal journal-finance-procurement-match-app-20261110; Procurement match bill-match-dev-401700 advanced to posted v2; lines clearing 240000 / tax 16800 / payable 256800.
runtime.matched_void: The holding owner voided the bill through the app route: invoice voided v3 with reversal journal invoice-reversal-finance-procurement-match-void-20261110; match returned v3 with invoice_id NULL; receipt inactive; fulfillment invoice_id NULL, version 3.
runtime.stale_source: A changed Commerce source returns 409 SUPPLIER_BILL_SOURCE_CHANGED with application/json on both the app route and direct 3198; log .scratch/dev/rust-migration/current/finance-source-version-stale-runtime.log

review.verdict: REJECT (previous review, before the receipt/repair/FX-gate fixes)
fixed_after_review: Procurement match post/void lifecycle with events and receipt deactivation.
Price-variance journal lines and variance test.
Receipt-version validation for every active match receipt (consolidated matches).
FX matched void fails closed; FX native post is scoped to the retained goods-FX path.
Matched void is exposed in the Finance UI.
remaining_blockers: Native foreign-currency Commerce posting is still not implemented; the retained legacy goods-carrying FX path handles it via a scoped fallback.
Browser acceptance for matched void has not been run after the UI change.
Procurement notifications are not written by the native match port (event only); retained Collaboration consumer.
Consolidated multi-receipt validation is implemented but has no dedicated test.
Stale match-version CAS and negative-variance tests are not present.

remaining: Finance payables is not certified. Finance remains 9/10 workflows and 5/41 owners.
The 6-subagent roster and Common frozen-bundle coordination remain absent; only reviewer/verifier subagents were used.
